# Mother, Baby & Child Magazine UAE

> > UAE's longest-established parenting magazine covering pregnancy, child health, family lifestyle, and parenting guidance for modern families.

Mother, Baby & Child is a comprehensive resource for parents and families in the UAE, published by CPI Media Group. The magazine combines expert medical advice, wellness guidance, and lifestyle content tailored to the Dubai and UAE community.
